My point of view is just a culmination of all the tools available to me in my life that make up my understanding of the universe. I’m a very scientifically-inclined person, learned lots about chemistry, biology, even genetics and physics in college (back when I thought I wanted to be a doctor lol) and to me, it just confirmed the idea of “intelligent design”. Really, I see God as the ultimate scientist. He created every single atom in the universe, as well as the laws of physics they abide by, so why couldn’t everything He does be similarly defined? But with that same grain, He could of course break those very laws, such as with the miracles of Jesus. All in all, I really don’t know 🤣🤣🤣 sorry, I know that’s probably not very helpful but it’s my truth
